tasks_completed.description: AC1/AC2 — handleSidebarDrop: synthesize deselected meal option back into editorTripData slots options[]
tasks_completed.changes: Inside handleSidebarDrop (line ~2338), when direction=board and srcSlotId is a meal slot: check if the option exists only in publishedDay.meals (PLAN-format, never in editorDay.slots[slotId].options[]). If so, push a synthesized option object into editorTripData.days[n].slots[srcSlotId].options[] before calling setEditorSelections null. Mirrors preserveCurrentAccommodationOption pattern.
tasks_completed.rationale: CandidatesSidebar mealsGroup is built exclusively from editorDay.slots[slotId].options[]. Items present only in publishedDay.meals were never synthesized and therefore never reappeared in sidebar after board→sidebar drag.

tasks_completed.description: AC3 — applyBridge (~line 2921): move semantics — remove option from originSlotId.options[] after sidebar→board drag
tasks_completed.changes: Added a second setEditorTripData call inside applyBridge after the cross-slot option-copy block. When originSlotId differs from targetSlotId, filters out the moved option_id from editorTripData.days[n].slots[originSlotId].options[]. Same-slot drags (originSlotId === targetSlotId) are unaffected.
tasks_completed.rationale: applyBridge previously used highlight-not-move semantics (M17b original spec). Users reported the sidebar card stays after board drop — expectation is move, not copy.

tasks_completed.description: AC4/AC5 — recomputeBudget (~line 2715): merge entry.breakdown into editorTripData.days[n].budget with key mapping
tasks_completed.changes: After the fetch('/api/budget/recompute') response, added a setEditorTripData call that maps: breakdown.meals→budget.meals, breakdown.activities→budget.attractions, breakdown.accommodation→budget.accommodation, breakdown.transportation→budget.transportation. Supports both scalar and object-with-amount breakdown shapes. Stale-seq guard applied before the merge.
tasks_completed.rationale: recomputeBudget previously discarded entry.breakdown entirely, persisting only day_total in liveDayTotal. Budget category rows remained stale after editor selections.

tasks_completed.description: AC6 — Meals candidate label (~line 2525): fixed to lang-conditional '餐厅' / 'Restaurant'
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced conditional mealsLabel (which rendered the slot name, e.g. 'dinner'/'lunch'/'breakfast') with fixed `lang === 'local' ? '餐厅' : 'Restaurant'` in the candidate card header span.
tasks_completed.rationale: mealsLabel rendered the origin slot name, misleading users into thinking the option was restricted to that specific meal slot. Category label should be the cuisine type, not slot.

tasks_completed.description: AC22 — Remove required/late-arrival/missing/skipped badges from all card types (5 blocks removed)
tasks_completed.changes: Removed 5 badge blocks: meals slot badge block, cafe activity badge block, attraction activity badge block, entertainment activity badge block, accommodation badge block. All were marked with AC22 comment.
tasks_completed.rationale: Badge UI was cluttering card view with status annotations that users found confusing and unnecessary in the editor context.

blast_radius.note: Template is consumed by html_generator.py to produce self-contained HTML bundles. Changes affect all generated trip HTML files. The beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 trip HTML was regenerated and deployed.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — original design gaps, not regressions
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: CandidatesSidebar built from editorDay.slots[].options[] only; PLAN-format items in publishedDay.meals never bridged. recomputeBudget designed to update total display only. applyBridge designed for highlight-not-move per M17b spec.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: AC1/AC2: synthesize publishedDay.meals items into options[] on board→sidebar drag. AC3: filter removed option from originSlot.options[] on sidebar→board drag. AC4/AC5: merge breakdown categories into editorTripData.budget after recompute. AC6: use fixed category label independent of slot name.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Five distinct fixes across separate functions; badge removals account for 20 of the 35 deleted lines (5 blocks x ~4 lines each). No padding or unnecessary additions.

self_verification.notes: Code-level verification confirmed: handleSidebarDrop at line 2338 contains AC1/AC2 synthesis block; applyBridge at line 2949 contains AC3 filter block; recomputeBudget at line 2737 contains AC4/AC5 breakdown merge; line 2528 shows lang-conditional '餐厅'/'Restaurant' label; AC22 badge blocks absent from deployed HTML (grep count=0). Playwright behavioral smoke check: AC6 confirmed (sidebar shows '🍽️ 餐厅' in Local mode, no 'dinner'/'lunch'/'breakfast' labels). AC22 confirmed (badge count=0 in DOM). AC1/AC2 partial: board dinner card became non-draggable after synthetic board→sidebar drag event (deselection triggered), but synthetic DragEvent cannot invoke React onDrop handlers directly — full behavioral proof requires interactive QA session. AC3 similarly not fully verifiable via synthetic events. AC4/AC5 require a live selection + /api/budget/recompute call to verify budget row update. Deployed HTML (05:51 2026-05-26) at /var/www/travel/beijing-lijiang-dali/2026-04-18/index.html contains all fix patterns (grep confirmed 13 occurrences of key fix identifiers). Live server at localhost:8094 confirmed serving updated content.

dev.qa_notes: AC6 and AC22 are directly observable in the UI. AC1/AC2 require: select a dinner from board (so it is in editorSelections), then drag it back to sidebar — verify it reappears as a candidate card. AC3 requires: drag a candidate from sidebar to a board slot — verify the candidate card disappears from sidebar. AC4/AC5 require: make any selection change, wait for recomputeBudget fetch to complete, verify budget category rows update. Test URL: http://localhost:8094/trip/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846

recommendations: QA should test AC1/AC2 with an item that exists only in publishedDay.meals (not in editorDay.slots[].options[]) — flight-day meals (breakfast/lunch) are ideal candidates as they are PLAN-format only.
AC3 same-slot drag (originSlotId === targetSlotId) should be explicitly verified not to remove the option from sidebar.
AC4/AC5 budget merge should be tested with both scalar and object-with-amount breakdown shapes from /api/budget/recompute.
